title: 2027-2028 Inria/Collegium Fellowship
institution: Collegium de Lyon (Institut d'études avancées de Lyon) and Inria
level: Professors or equivalent researchers based outside France
about: The Collegium de Lyon and Inria host one researcher in 2027-2028 for 5 to 10 months in Lyon, France. Applicants hold a professorship or equivalent post outside France and need support from a Lyon Saint-Etienne Inria team. Deadline: 29 January 2027, 6 pm Paris time.
requirements: Professorship or equivalent research post at an institution outside France
Project in digital science and technology supported by an Inria team at the Lyon Saint-Etienne site
